highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.156.0 previews the Skia m156 renderer with expanded native platform support.
highlights_body: This preview restores Linux system-font discovery for NoDependencies deployments, adds native GTK4 GPU rendering, and refreshes build support for .NET 11, Windows, and Tizen.

bullets.detail: Aligns the bundled renderer with Chrome milestone 156 for consumers evaluating the next SkiaSharp release line.
Incorporates the m155 core-fork cleanup into the current release line to keep the bundled native engine integration current.
NoDependencies deployments on Linux can again discover system fonts, restoring text rendering behavior that depended on the system font manager.
GTK4 applications gain native GPU rendering with pixel-scaling support for sharper, better-aligned output.
Updates preview SDK pins and WebAssembly native assets so package consumers can evaluate the 4.156 line with .NET 11 previews.
Packages and builds now target the Tizen 10 GCC 14.2 toolchain.

contributor_summaries.ramezgerges: Restored Linux system-font discovery for NoDependencies deployments

preview_summaries.v4.156.0-preview.1.26512.10: Preview 1 opens the 4.156 line with Skia m156, native GTK4 GPU rendering, restored Linux NoDependencies font discovery, and refreshed native platform support.

harfbuzz_summary: Refreshes HarfBuzzSharp native build support for .NET 11 previews, current Windows toolchains, and Tizen 10 packaging.

v4.156.0-preview.1.26512.10.headline: SkiaSharp 4.156.0 Preview 1 introduces the Skia m156 engine update and broader native platform support.
v4.156.0-preview.1.26512.10.body: It restores Linux system-font discovery for NoDependencies deployments, adds native GTK4 GPU rendering, and aligns package assets with current .NET 11, Windows, and Tizen toolchains.
